You're not alone. Help is here.

Feeling a lot right now is okay. You can take a break, skip any scenario, and come back when you're ready. Your progress is saved.

  • In danger right now? Call 911.
  • 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. Call or text 988 (or chat at 988lifeline.org). Free, private, and open 24/7.
  • Crisis Text Line. Text HOME to 741741.
  • Someone close by. Talk to your school counselor or a trusted adult. You can tell your teacher you need to go.

Take a break: breathe in slowly for 4, then out for 6. Repeat a few times. Closing this window puts you right back where you were.
